uploadsafety-upload-rejected: Error shown when an image upload is blocked by a moderation check.
uploadsafety-upload-rejected-debug: Debug error shown when an image upload is blocked. $1 is screening detail (checks, labels, scores, threshold).
uploadsafety-upload-unavailable: Error shown when a moderation check cannot be reached and the upload is rejected.
uploadsafety-upload-unavailable-debug: Debug error shown when a moderation check fails. $1 is the failure reason.
uploadsafety-debug-approved: Notice shown on the next page after a successful image upload when debug mode is enabled. $1 is screening detail (checks, labels, scores, threshold).
